opsmill-auto.name: OpsMill end to end
opsmill-auto.description: Runs the opsmill-prep workflow, then the opsmill-implement workflow when prep reports that the spec is ready.
opsmill-auto.author: opsmill

opsmill-implement.name: OpsMill implementation
opsmill-implement.description: Implements the tasks of a spec directory chunk by chunk, reviews the result, then writes a report. Each phase is one step, and the workflow sets when the chunk step is repeated and how often.
opsmill-implement.author: opsmill

opsmill-prep.name: OpsMill preparation
opsmill-prep.description: Prepares a feature for implementation: specify, plan and critique, tasks, then an alignment check against the request. Each phase is one step, and the workflow sets when a phase is repeated and how often.
opsmill-prep.author: opsmill
